title: helichrysum roseum var. typicum
intro: Helichrysum roseum var. typicum, commonly known as the false yellowhead, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, terpenes, and sesquiterpenes.
